description: Exploit: finish the early-resolution dial. The tip is E036 (9.25 true epochs, about 231 steps at batch 2000; 20/24/28/32 px at 30/10/30/30%; whitening bias detached after 20%; group-1 freeze at 75%). Change only the resolution split, from 30/10/30/30 to 40/0/30/30: the 24 px phase (about 23 steps) now runs at 20 px. The 28 px and 32 px phases keep their exact step counts and positions. The LR, Lookahead, whitening-detach and freeze schedules stay unchanged. The 20 px graphs (full and whitening-detached variants) are already captured in build. The 24 px graphs can be dropped from build. error_on_recompile stays on. Judge on held-out seeds 3–12 as well as seeds 0–2, and discount held-out by about 0.1 pp for the winner's curse (E038). Keep if seeds 0–2 ≥ 0.753 and held-out ≥ 0.7545.
